rules.fixed_denominator: The 15 rows are frozen when the matrix is accepted; missing, queued, cancelled, infrastructure-failed, hard-failed and event-censored rows are never removed.
rules.unattempted: An unattempted row is not a pass and remains in the denominator until it has a terminal execution receipt and scientific audit.
rules.infrastructure_failure: A worker/input/decoder failure is recorded with its row and remains a failed or unresolved denominator entry; it cannot be silently replaced by a different q or resolution.
rules.hard_integrity_failure: Any native identity loss, nonfinite value, closed-face endpoint violation, saved-frame chord crossing, or mass-gate failure fails the row even if the solver reaches 5 s.
rules.event_censor: A row that reaches 5 s without motion completion, receiver contact, spill classification, settled conjunction, and 0.35 s post-settle output fails event completeness; no horizon extension is permitted in this matrix.
rules.same_input_retry: Repeating the same prepared input after a scientific failure is forbidden; a new attempt requires a new preregistered physical hypothesis and a new case identity.
rules.canary_exclusion: The completed q=.5 and q=1.0 DBC development canaries and all mDBC/open-tray canaries remain historical evidence only; they cannot credit, replace or shrink these 15 rows.
rules.static_exclusion: A zero-motion static hold is not a dynamic row and cannot establish this third mechanism family.
rules.threshold_policy: No threshold, ownership, event definition, survivor denominator or wall-face contract may be relaxed after seeing a result.
rules.lineage_policy: physical_geometry_changed=true is retained relative to static v3 source; the duration-only single-variable rule is evaluated relative to the existing q=.5/q=1.0 native-DBC dynamic baselines where the catchment side-wall geometry is frozen.
rules.promotion: Only 15/15 independent rows with hard_integrity_pass=true and event_window_complete=true may support a future T1 review; this file grants no qualification.

stop_conditions.if_q0p75_preflight_fails: retain the preflight failure, do not create a job or launch a solver, and require a new root-reviewed input hypothesis
stop_conditions.if_q0p75_solver_hard_fails: retain the row failure and stop same-input retries; review whether a distinct mechanism is justified
stop_conditions.if_q0p75_solver_is_event_censored: retain the event failure; do not extend beyond 5 s or reinterpret static hold as dynamic evidence
stop_conditions.if_any_cell_missing: matrix remains incomplete regardless of other passing rows

qualification_claim: none; denominator and failure policy only
